title: CERTIFYING COUNTERFACTUAL BIAS IN LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the formal certification of bias in LLMs, specifically addressing representational harms, social stereotypes, and disparate outcomes. These topics are core components of AI ethics and fairness. The entire research objective is to evaluate the ethical alignment of models regarding sensitive demographic groups (gender, race) and to quantify their adherence to fairness standards, which goes beyond a simple ethical considerations section.
